artifact_kind: Claim gates, recipe risk review and qualified terminal processor comparison; no manuscript or final paper

results.statement: All twelve saved inventories cover 23,651 numeric occurrences; all 23,519 common normalized comparisons agree exactly. The source outcomes remain nine clean, one incomplete DTS and two RSS telemetry failures.
results.mandatory_qualification: Saved complete artifacts do not recode the two live_process_rss_missing outcomes as successful execution or validation. These were missing-telemetry failures, not observed RSS-cap exceedances. The incomplete source retains its missing SIC dependency. No natural QA or new algorithm is measured.

results.statement: The fixed 12-source conversion request contains 21 selected tables and 80 unique neighbors: 98 of 101 blocks were converted/rasterized; three fail-closed RSS telemetry stops remain recorded.
results.mandatory_qualification: Conversion is not source/CSS/semantic admission. Separate actual visual review is incomplete in this record. No browser fidelity, complete-evidence pack, question or reference is established.

results.statement: The sole loader/tokenizer attempt stops at the fresh pressure-proxy-plus-reserve gate before asset rehash or native process launch. All eight planned authored prompts remain unattempted; zero prompts are tokenized and zero completions are called.
results.mandatory_qualification: This is a retained resource-feasibility refusal. It provides no native compatibility, generation, buffer-allocation or reader-quality measurement. The static cache estimate remains unmeasured. A later separately frozen attempt is reported as V17-R05; it does not alter this outcome.

results.statement: The bounded identity selector processes all twelve sources and proposes 34 unique blocks covering 34 of 36 required source fields. Both SLB issuer fields remain unavailable under its exact visible-match rule.
results.mandatory_qualification: Candidate selection is not visual admission or a complete identity card. The original 101-block conversion denominator remains unchanged; extra identity dependencies need a separate render/review record. No question, reference or model prediction was produced.

results.statement: The separately frozen follow-up starts one native process after exact asset and reserve checks, then the application watchdog kills partial loading when shared cgroup total reaches 8 GiB. No health/identity success, tokenization or completion is obtained.
results.mandatory_qualification: This was a sampled equality-stop, not an observed kernel OOM kill or a model-memory requirement. Both OOM counter deltas are zero. Partial-loading RSS and the cache-pressure explanation do not prove full-model fit. Removing the equality stop remains a separately reviewed proposal; no additional policy experiment was executed.

results.statement: All 21 fixed table bundles are materialized with 40 separately identified dependency blocks. Source-only staging projections are physically separated from the privileged typed registry. Every population remains null and no complete bundle or author release is admitted.
results.mandatory_qualification: Source-conditioned dependency suggestions require independent semantic and source-view review. Ten interface-shape candidates pass syntax; eleven retain block_text failures caused by mandatory empty neighbors. No neighbor is dropped, interface schema changed, natural question/reference authored, or prediction made. Syntax successes are not evaluable packs.

results.statement: The fixed original population has 101 qualified views available across separate original, telemetry-recovery and contrast-recovery attempts. The identity population has 33 of 34 qualified views, and four additional SLB cover views support only literal visible wording. No complete source identity card or evidence pack is admitted.
results.mandatory_qualification: Original conversion and visual failures remain unchanged. Post-inspection recoveries do not establish browser equivalence. Identity views, SLB literal views and forty unrendered bundle dependencies remain separate populations. Hidden DEI/legal-name equivalence and semantic attachment remain unverified.

planned_stage_A_denominators.interpretation: Design counts only; none is an executed or admitted result.

recipe_risks.finding: The inherited protocol alternates B1/B2 order by issuer/slot parity, whereas the native natural-request validator requires B1 then B2 for every case.
recipe_risks.required_resolution: New v17 schedule and validator must agree; preserve the v16 driver unchanged.
recipe_risks.resolution: v17 explicitly supersedes draft parity with adjacent B1 then B2; disclose fixed-order latency confound and independent cold servers.

recipe_risks.finding: The original fixed table pool is revenue/duration-focused; its 21 selected tables do not establish admissibility of later instant/other-quantity Stage B slots.
recipe_risks.required_resolution: Keep Stage A scope explicit and log Stage B admission failures; any changed source pool is a separately frozen development amendment.
recipe_risks.resolution: Stage B and instant/ambiguity slots are outside this workflow; no later admission implied.

recipe_risks.finding: A tiny authored interface gate does not demonstrate that complete natural evidence fits the input budget or permits full-context generation.
recipe_risks.required_resolution: Tokenize every complete B1/B2 request with the pinned native template; keep over-budget slots and never remove competing rows to fit.

recipe_risks.finding: B1 and B2 have different emission schemas, while the 768-token output cap can constrain citation-rich beams well before the maximum eight hypotheses.
recipe_risks.required_resolution: Record realized hypothesis/claim counts and output-limit failures; beam-eight recall means recall in the available bounded beam, not eight hypotheses guaranteed. Do not claim isolation of the renderer effect.
recipe_risks.resolution: Actual returned beam size, joint-hypothesis recall and output-limit failures are explicit.

recipe_risks.finding: Fresh model roles remain correlated model annotation, and complete evidence is selected with reference knowledge.
recipe_risks.required_resolution: Mask typed records and references from authors, isolate reviewers and evaluated processes, retain adjudication, and label the experiment as an oracle-evidence development diagnostic.

recipe_risks.finding: Withheld relations may leak through repeated labels, text, source/version metadata, dimensions or identifiers even when one binding cell is null.
recipe_risks.required_resolution: Review the entire exposed projection and question for remaining authorization evidence; a leaking control is unavailable before prediction, not a model failure.

recipe_risks.finding: The phrase automatic reader could include B0, while the inherited protocol separately requires residual-need analysis if only B0 passes.
recipe_risks.required_resolution: State the B0-only continuation rule explicitly; never treat it as evidence that a new retrieval method is needed.
recipe_risks.resolution: Only B1/B2 qualify for the model gate; B0-only success requires residual-need analysis and model diagnosis.

recipe_risks.finding: Method-name masking alone cannot blind semantic grading when arm-specific raw schemas or hypothesis/finalizer traces reveal the method.
recipe_risks.required_resolution: Create the same canonical final-action/quantity/scope/citation grading view for every arm, omit arm diagnostics from the semantic grader and disclose remaining structural distinguishability. Keep B1 proposal scoring separate.
recipe_risks.resolution: Common canonical grading projection specified, arm-specific diagnostics excluded, residual distinguishability disclosed.

recipe_risks.finding: Legacy source cards copy DEI values without visibility flags, so hidden fiscal fields can be misrepresented as visibly supported author context.
recipe_risks.required_resolution: Build twelve reviewed visible issuer/report/date cards; omit hidden-only optional fields; separately freeze/render additional cover blocks without changing the 101-block denominator.

prohibited_current_claims: Full XBRL or SEC filing-rule conformance
publication_gate: Completed preparation/failure-analysis checkpoint only. Numerical table cells and evidence hashes are bound; no admitted natural questions, references, answerable packs, model quality, retrieval gain or algorithmic novelty is claimed.

attribution_required: Answer-equivalence-class and weighted cross-class edge cutting: EC2 (Golovin, Krause and Ray, 2010).
Correlated noisy tests: ECED (Chen, Hassani and Krause, 2017).
Budgeted adaptive acquisition/stopping: compare cost-aware RAG baselines identified in the source note.
needed_before_a_method_claim: Demonstrate residual attachment failures after a competent complete-evidence reader gate.
Compare generic sufficiency, explicitly EC2-inspired separation and any dependency-aware lookahead under identical proposals, actions, verifier, reader and measured cost accounting.
Preserve true-binding omission and false elimination; finite-beam agreement is not exhaustive correctness.
not_inherited: Theoretical guarantees from EC2/ECED do not transfer without their assumptions.
Two-action lookahead does not establish a novel algorithm or theorem by itself.
This source note is a targeted literature check, not an exhaustive novelty review.

proposed_native_policy.scope: Guard semantics assessment only; all previous failures preserved and shared-cgroup risk explicit.
